Title: Superman/Shazam!: The Return of Black Adam
FullTitle: Superman/Shazam!: The Return of Black Adam
SortTitle: Superman/Shazam!: The Return of Black Adam
Plot: Chosen the world’s protector against the Seven Deadly Enemies of Man – pride, envy, greed, hatred, selfishness, laziness and injustice – young Billy Batson accepts his destiny as Captain Marvel. Battling alongside Superman against nefarious Black Adam, Billy soon discovers the challenge super heroes ultimately face: is it revenge or justice?
Tagline: We fight for those you can't fight for themselves!
